ORDINANCE III OF 2011
ORDINANCE III OF 2011
FEDERAL EXCISE (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2011
An Ordinance further to amend the
Federal Excise Act, 2005
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
15th March, 2011]
No.F.2(I)/2011-Pub, dated
15-3-2011.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the President is hereby
published for general information:'---
Whereas it is expedient to amend the Federal Excise
Act, 2005, for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the Senate and the National Assembly are
not in session and the President is satisfied that circumstances exist which
render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by
clause (1) of Article 89 of the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of
Pakistan, the Pr.,;ident is pleased
to make and promulgate the following Ordinance:--
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Federal Excise (Amendment) Ordinance, 2011.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

Amendment of section 3A, the Federal Excise Act, 2005

2. Amendment of section 3A, the Federal Excise
Act, 2005.---In the Federal Excise Act, 2005, in section 3A, in subsection

substituted.
